title: Harmony Heights | Modern Rooftop City Retreat
description:
Modern and spacious 3BR/3BA unit with 1 king and 4 queen beds—perfect for families, groups, or work trips. Enjoy a stunning rooftop deck with a cozy firepit and amazing downtown views. Features a stylish living area, sleek kitchenette, 3 full bathrooms, and private balcony. Sleeps up to 12 comfortably. Located minutes from top restaurants, nightlife, and attractions. The ideal spot for relaxing, entertaining, or exploring the city!

The space
This is a modern Nashville retreat designed for style, comfort, and group stays.

Bedrooms: 3

Bathrooms: 3

Beds: 5

Living Areas: Open-concept living and dining spaces for socializing

Kitchen: Fully equipped for cooking and entertaining

Outdoor Space: Private rooftop patio with cushioned seating, fire pit, and dining area

Other Amenities: high-speed Wi-Fi, and comfortable furnishings

Whether you’re relaxing on the rooftop, enjoying a home-cooked meal, or exploring Nashville’s music, food, and nightlife, Melody & Moonlight provides the perfect base for an unforgettable stay.

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
